name: sft-ideal-from-gold
hypothesis: SFT on prep_sft_ideal.py output (assistant = <answer>{gold_json}</answer>) with rank=4 alpha=8 lr=1e-4, 16 examples filtered to chars<2000

data.source: datasets/sft.ideal.short.jsonl (188 synthesized, filtered to 77 with chars<2000, --max-examples 16 = shortest 16)

verdict: no-ship — flat (0.12σ). Outcome lifted (+0.021) but invariant_coverage dropped (-0.069), surface-form overfit. Same pattern as Stage 1c (strict prompt): outcome up, structure down.
lessons: Tiny SFT on 16 gold-derived examples is too small to push composite without overfitting surface form.
The composite has a real tradeoff: outcome lift correlates with structure drop for this rubric.
Filter chars<2000 (~600 tok) avoided OOM but biased toward simpler tasks.
